Manager.Title: Manage snippets
Manager.Name: Name
Manager.EmptyCreateHint: No snippets yet. Use New to create one.
ToolTip.Settings.EnableLogging: Writes diagnostic events to the local log file. Leave off unless you are investigating a problem.
ToolTip.Settings.PrewarmOnStartup: Initializes screen capture and OCR when Scrybe starts so the first capture is faster.
ToolTip.Settings.CleanupMode: Chooses how OCR text is cleaned before copy or injection. Raw changes nothing; Standard fixes common OCR noise; Log Cleaner removes log prefixes; Code Formatter preserves code layout.
ToolTip.Settings.EnablePreprocessing: Improves OCR by normalizing the captured image before recognition. Disable only when it hurts a specific source.
ToolTip.Settings.InjectionMode: Unicode types characters independent of keyboard layout. Scancode uses the active keyboard layout for apps that reject Unicode input.
ToolTip.Settings.ClearClipboardAfterInje: Clears Scrybe's clipboard payload after typing so captured text does not linger there.
ToolTip.Settings.Pacing: Delay between synthetic keystrokes. Increase it for slow remote consoles that drop characters.
ToolTip.Settings.InjectionIntegrity: Runs a deterministic injection payload for comparing Unicode and Scancode behavior.
ToolTip.Settings.CapturesDirectory: Folder where debug captures and saved crop images are written.
ToolTip.Settings.SaveCaptureCrop: Saves the selected screen region as PNG for OCR troubleshooting. Usually keep this off.
ToolTip.Settings.EnableCaptureHistory: Stores OCR results in the protected local history so you can re-copy or edit recent captures.
ToolTip.Settings.HistoryMaxEntries: Maximum number of protected history items to keep. Older entries are discarded first.
ToolTip.Manager.Template: Snippet body to inject. Use {{name}} placeholders for values you will fill at injection time.
ToolTip.Manager.Parameters: Optional parameter definitions. The name column must match a {{name}} placeholder in the template.
ToolTip.Manager.DetectParameters: Adds missing parameter rows from {{name}} placeholders in the template.
ToolTip.Secrets.DiscreetMode: Hides usernames in the quick secret palette for screen sharing.
Manager.ParametersAlreadyDetected: All template parameters are already listed
Manager.ParametersNoneDetected: No {{name}} parameters found in the template

Persist.ReloadHelp: Read current files without saving. Review your draft before saving again.

Validation.NativeTitle: Scrybe controlled input test  -  synthetic text only
Validation.ReceiverHelp: Inject the reference below into the empty receiver. Synthetic text only. Reports contain counts and error rate, not received text.
Validation.Mismatch: Mismatch. Error rate saved; inspect the receiver before retrying.
Review.Title: Review captured text
Review.Hint: Correct the text alongside the original crop. Accept copies the edited text and records it in history when enabled. Cancel leaves the clipboard and last capture unchanged. Use Tab from a button to navigate; Ctrl+Tab leaves the text editor.
Profiles.Title: Application injection profiles
Profiles.Hint: Use the process name without .exe (for example mstsc). Each confirmation shows the selected mode and delays. Remote applications sharing one client process share its profile.
Profiles.Invalid: Profiles must have unique process names without .exe, a valid mode, and delays within the supported range.
Profiles.Confirmation: Injection: {0}; key delay {1} ms; extra delay after Enter {2} ms.
Backup.Title: Versions and restoration
Backup.Hint: Select a local version, then review its metadata before confirming restoration. The last 20 versions of each store are retained; deleted secrets and history may remain in those versions. Protected values remain encrypted for the same Windows account and machine. Restoring settings requires restarting Scrybe. An empty list means no older saved versions are available.
Backup.Confirm: Restore {0} from {1:g}? This version contains {2} records and {3:N0} bytes. The current version will be saved first. Restart Scrybe after restoring settings; reload open editors before saving drafts.
Backup.Restored: Version restored. Libraries reloaded. Reload open editors; restart Scrybe to apply restored settings.
Backup.Failed: Restoration failed or the preview is stale. Review the current versions again.
Exchange.Preview: Import all {0} snippets ({1} conflicts with the current library). Review names below and choose how conflicts are handled. Secret and history stores are excluded. Templates can contain sensitive text entered manually: review them before sharing.
Exchange.Policy: Conflict policy for all imported snippets
Exchange.Exported: Committed snippets exported to a new file.
Exchange.SaveDraftFirst: Save or explicitly discard the current draft before importing.
Exchange.Failed: Exchange failed: check the format, limits (4 MiB / 1000 snippets), duplicate identities, file permissions or a changed library. Export requires a new file.
